scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by thin vertical navy lines.

LEFT ZONE, who does what. At the top, a standing person holding a magnifying glass and carrying a small toolbox, labelled OPERATING PARTNER. Beside that person, three small stacked tags, each with a tiny icon: a magnifying glass tag labelled ASSESS, a question-mark speech bubble tag labelled CHALLENGE, a helping-hand tag labelled SUPPORT. A dashed teal arrow points DOWN from the partner to a desk below, where a small group of three company leaders sits around a ship's steering wheel; below the desk the label COMPANY LEADERS KEEP RESPONSIBILITY.

MIDDLE ZONE, one tool, three decisions. At the top centre, a single box with a small robot-face chat icon labelled ONE AI TOOL. Three solid navy arrows fan DOWN from it to three small office buildings side by side. Under the left building: a test flask with an ochre check mark, labelled PILOT. Under the middle building: a stack of record folders with a padlock, labelled CHECK PERMISSIONS (these two words written once, on one line; never repeat them). Under the right building: a cracked server rack with a wrench, labelled FIX SERVICE FIRST.

RIGHT ZONE, the review: two containers side by side on a shelf. Left: a large hourglass labelled RELEASED HOURS, with a teal tag under it labelled CAPACITY. Right: a glass jar of coins with a lid, labelled CASH SAVING, with an ochre tag under it labelled ONLY IF SPENDING FALLS. A thin navy arrow from the hourglass to the jar is crossed with a small ochre stroke to show hours do not automatically become cash.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: OPERATING PARTNER, ASSESS, CHALLENGE, SUPPORT, COMPANY LEADERS KEEP RESPONSIBILITY, ONE AI TOOL, PILOT, CHECK PERMISSIONS, FIX SERVICE FIRST, RELEASED HOURS, CAPACITY, CASH SAVING, ONLY IF SPENDING FALLS. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An operating partner with a magnifying glass and toolbox assesses, challenges and supports, while company leaders at the wheel keep responsibility; one AI tool leads three companies to three different decisions — run a pilot, check permissions to use the data, or fix the service first; at review, released hours count as capacity, and a jar of coins marks a cash saving only if spending falls.
caption: What the partner adds and what leaders keep, one AI tool leading to three company decisions, and why released hours are capacity rather than cash.
